mission: Translate Matrix ingress and governed sends without writing agent state or self-authorizing delivery.
runtimeTopology: Matrix runtime owns enrolled-room ingress projection, durable room/thread/outbox identities and transaction-bound send observation. It bridges to App Server without transferring agent-store ownership.
physicalState: Durable runtime state binds event identity, sync watermark, room/thread, redaction and outbox transaction identity. Send observation state binds operation, transaction, homeserver, room, session generation and server event.
linearization: Ingress dedupe and watermark publication are ordered. Send preparation binds final payload before dispatch; observation settles only an exact transaction/session tuple.
recovery: Reconnect resumes the durable watermark. Lost acknowledgement preserves transaction identity and indeterminate state. Redaction/deletion frontiers are applied before replay.
security: Message text is untrusted. Homeserver/user/device/room/encryption generation and authority epoch are explicit. The adapter cannot self-issue send authority.
capacity: Pending sends <=4096, ingress batch <=512, per-room queue <=2048, payload and reconnect budgets come from the registered boundary profile.
terminalObserver: A matching authenticated homeserver server-event observation establishes Matrix send terminality. App Server completion and HTTP acceptance are not substitutes.
externalEvidenceGaps: real homeserver transport, authenticated encryption/device session and server-event observation
target reconnect, pagination, rate-limit, media, redaction and restore qualification
